findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_page, deploy_app · Private data: publish_page, deploy_app · Public sink: publish_page, deploy_app · Destructive: publish_page, deploy_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_page, deploy_app · Private data: publish_page, deploy_app · Public sink: publish_page, deploy_app · Destructive: publish_page, deploy_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
